channel.title: Aether Notifications
channel.description: Site updates and important notifications for Aether users

item.title: New Integrations: Simkl Sync & Letterboxd Import!
item.description:
We've added two highly requested integrations to make tracking your media and migrating your watchlists easier than ever!
✨ Simkl Integration (Full Sync) Keep your watch history and bookmarks synced with Simkl: - Connect your Simkl account in Settings → Connections. - Automatically sync your bookmarks with your Simkl "Plan to Watch" list. - Automatically sync movies and TV show episodes as you watch them, so your progress is always backed up.
📥 Letterboxd Watchlist Import Migrate your Letterboxd watchlist straight into Aether bookmarks in seconds: - Go to Settings → Import. - Upload your watchlist.csv export from Letterboxd (Settings → Data → Export your data). - Aether will automatically match each film on TMDB and add it directly to your bookmarks with full metadata and posters!
Head over to Settings to try them out!

item.title: New Feature (Experimental): Automatic Subtitle Sync
item.description:
Subtitles that drift out of sync with the audio are now a thing of the past!
Tired of manually adjusting the subtitle delay every episode — or worse, when it slips mid-episode? Aether can now listen to the audio and realign subtitles automatically.
- Enable it once in the player under Subtitles → Customize → "Auto-sync with audio" - Works while you watch — no uploading, no waiting, nothing to configure - Handles offsets of any size — small drifts lock in seconds, while big mismatches (30s, 60s, even more) are found by a wide-range search that needs a little more listening time - Your manual [ and ] adjustments always take priority, and the sync never fights you
**Note: this feature is experimental.** It needs clear dialogue to work well and may struggle with music-heavy scenes — if it misbehaves, just toggle it off.
Enable it in the subtitle settings and never fiddle with subtitle delay again!
